dataset_name: Acoustic Signal Dataset: Tall Coconut Fruit Species
audio_formats: xlsx-embedded-signals (16-bit PCM 44.1 kHz, 132,300 samples per signal)

labels.scheme: maturity level codes in file names / sheet split: im (premature, 8 coconuts), m (mature, 36), om (overmature, 85)
labels.ground_truth_method: expert pre-classification by local farmers and experts

capture_method: mechanical knocking arm + ATR2500 USB condenser microphone, acoustic-foam enclosure
redistribution_blockers: CC BY-NC-ND: NoDerivatives — repackaging into GitHub parts is a prohibited derivative
single-file size 278,424,725 bytes exceeds the 100,000,000-byte GitHub limit
known_limitations: Not onions: coconut maturity, not onion internal defect
NoDerivatives license forbids redistribution of a repacked copy
Signals embedded in XLSX; no standalone WAVs shipped
Class imbalance: 8 / 36 / 85 coconuts across maturity levels
permitted_local_uses: Pipeline testing and DSP benchmarking locally (NonCommercial)
Methodological reference for collection protocol design
not_permitted: Training or evaluating any model presented as an onion internal-defect classifier
Redistribution via GitHub or any public mirror

provenance.authors: J.A. Caladcad, E.J. Piedad, S. Cabahug, M.R. Catamco, P.E. Villaceran, L. Cosgafa, K.N. Cabizares, M. Hermosilla
provenance.sample_description: 129 tall-variety coconuts, 3 taps per coconut (Ridge A/B/C), 387 acoustic signals, Argao, Philippines
provenance.data_source_location: Argao, Philippines; recorded at University of San Jose-Recoletos, Cebu
